assets.title: Bored-Head Fire Axe Display
assets.description: One original static low-poly blunt fire-axe visual prop, lying flat in one fixed pose. A single continuous thick red metal-style head has a broad curved silver-coloured bit, a real geometric thickness taper, a finite blunt edge and poll, and a genuine rectangular handle eye passing completely through the head along the handle axis. One continuous lightly curved ochre wooden-style long handle passes through this eye, with finite lateral inset joints, visible upper end, a thicker shoulder and an integral thick dark grip end. The head broad underside and grip underside have real finite flat ground patches. Two named editable closed meshes, four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, source Z up, front -Y, origin on the handle centreline under the head at ground. One whole tool counts as one prop. No textures, logo, animation, separate wedge, sheath, rack, person, fire, target or scene. Static blunt visual geometry only. No chopping, breaking, cutting, sharpness, material hardness, strength, heat or fire resistance, wearer or hand fit, ergonomics, load, durability, stability, manufacturing tolerance, real tool use, firefighting performance or safety certification is claimed. Not real equipment design, manufacture or use guidance. No brand, model or compatibility with earlier tools or vehicles is asserted.
